TAXONOMY FLAG: Ugarte-Nunez 2020 uses the genus Histiotus (following the Cladio et al. 2023 Neoeptesicus/Histiotus split used elsewhere in this project). Pacheco et al. 2021, the authoritative Peru checklist fetched for this batch, instead places this species as Eptesicus montanus - a direct disagreement between two Peruvian sources published within a year of each other, not a project-side error. Matched to Eptesicus montanus in the coverage audit on the basis of shared authorship '(Philippi & Landbeck, 1861)' and identical species epithet. Ugarte-Nunez 2020, Ciencia & Desarrollo 27:37-48 (SciELO Preprints, full text fetched). Search-phase calls, southwest Peru (Arequipa, Moquegua, Tacna departments), coastal desert and western Andean slopes. Table 1: mean +/- SD, n = number of pulses measured (not individuals). Two call variants noted in the key text: ~32 kHz hawking flying insects in open air, and a distinct <20 kHz variant used for gleaning perched invertebrates near vegetation - only the open-air variant is in this quantitative table. Call type: FMd.
